Your tax dollars just bought a toilet that takes pictures of your ass.

Not a metaphor. NIH spent roughly $7 million of cancer research money on a “smart toilet” that photographs users from inside the bowl. NSF dropped $4.6 million studying whether drunk people fall down. Another $3 million went to whether eating ants stops global warming. Hot tubs got $2 million to confirm they reduce stress. Dentist fear got a million. Stress turning hair gray got $36 million. USAID sent $48 million so Tunisian youth could “cope with modern society,” then spent more teaching Central Americans how to apply for even more American grants.

This is not science. This is a racket. Bureaucrats write the checks, universities cash them, and the people who actually earned the money get the bill plus interest on the debt. No household would approve a single one of these. Congress funds them every year and then demands more.

The money is gone. The projects remain. The debt grows. And the same people who spent it will be back next cycle telling you the government is underfunded.
